notice_title: Play Rooms: you're responsible for what you say and do
notice_body: PS5Upload only gives you the tool to play together. We don't run, watch, record or moderate rooms, chat or voice, and we aren't responsible for what anyone says, shares or does in them, including names and room names. You're responsible for your own conduct and for following the law and the rules of the platforms and games you use. Only play with people you trust; you can mute, hide, remove or block anyone.
notice_parents: Parents: please supervise children who use Play Rooms.
notice_safety: Stay safe: don't share personal details, passwords or account information with people you don't know, and leave any room that makes you uncomfortable. Chat and voice go only between the people in the room and aren't saved.
terms_1: PS5Upload Play is free, unofficial and not affiliated with or endorsed by Sony Interactive Entertainment; PlayStation and PS5 are its trademarks, named only to say what the app works with. It comes with no warranty. You use it at your own risk: its makers aren't liable for lost data, damage to a console, bans or other action on your accounts.
terms_2: You're responsible for what you do with it: play only games you or your friends own, and follow the laws where you live and the terms of the platforms you use. PS5Upload Play doesn't provide games.
terms_3: Privacy: the app keeps its settings, pairings and log on this PS5 and sends no usage data. To find games over the internet it uses the PS5Upload hub, which sees this PS5's network address and what a listed room shows, keeps them in memory only while they're needed, and never carries chat, voice or video.
terms_4: Support is voluntary: a donation is a gift that buys nothing, unlocks nothing and isn't refundable.
terms_5: Full terms: github.com/phantomptr/ps5upload (DISCLAIMER.md). Legal questions or takedown requests: phantomptr@gmail.com.
